title: Coffee subscription site
brief: A small-batch coffee roaster that ships freshly roasted beans on a subscription. Build its marketing site: a home page that explains the offer, how the subscription works, this month's coffees, what subscribers say and common questions; and a plans page where people compare the three plans and pick one.

title: Studio booking app
brief: A booking app for members of a yoga and pilates studio. Build the signed-in app: a home screen with today's and this week's classes and the member's next booking; a class page with the teacher, level, spots left and a book button; and a page listing the member's bookings with past classes and their attendance streak.

title: City culture magazine
brief: An independent online magazine about city life: food, design, music and neighbourhoods. Build its front page with a lead story and the latest pieces by section, one long-read article page with its author and related stories, and a section page for one of the sections.
